ourKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
ourKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
ourKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
ourKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
ourKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
ourKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
ourKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
ourKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
ourKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
enemyKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Pick up Boulder Throw, Pounce in to shatter it on landing for an area stun, Rumble to slow, then Behemoth to grow, heal and get an instant Boulder Throw and longer Pounce.
enemyKits.winCondition: Engage with Pounce and Boulder Throw, then out-sustain fights in Behemoth, especially near several enemies.
enemyKits.passive: King of the Jungle: bonus health regeneration, doubled in the jungle, and tenacity plus a heal when he is immobilized.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that punishes the targets he stuns and knocks back.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge the thrown boulder and watch for him carrying one before a Pounce. Anti-heal cuts his regeneration and Behemoth healing, and kiting him out of Behemoth's duration wastes it.

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
enemyKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
enemyKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
enemyKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,366 hero damage a minute, more than 85% of Iggy & Scorch mid players this patch (27% of the team's). The damage came from Megacosm, Tainted Scepter, Entropy.
Inferno at rank 3: 85s base, about 59.4s by the end (30% shorter) from 43 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Tainted Scepter 10, Entropy 15, Epoch 8.
11 takedowns (4 kills, 7 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Iggy & Scorch dealt 43,713 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +340 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11; against Boris (level 16: about 56 magical armor, 45 after penetration; took 16,207 magical damage from heroes, 64% of all hero damage they took) and Morigesh (level 16: about 46 magical armor, 35 after penetration; took 10,615 magical damage from heroes, 43% of all hero damage they took) that is about 8% and 8% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).

Toughness: +450 health; took 23,585 damage, mitigated 12,673, died 3 times.

(game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 19.8% by the end (32 min)] Field: 50% in 8294 games, 69% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.5%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Vesh, Mind Rot. Iggy & Scorch has 4 damaging abilities (Molotov, Oil Spill, Inferno hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 43 ability haste brought them back 30% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with the target's health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Iggy & Scorch killed built magical armor (Shinbi). Health items on Boris, Shinbi raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Iggy & Scorch 3 times.

bullets: Line Tempo's short cooldown and Rushing Beat's 2 charges kept Megacosm's max-health damage over time refreshing and Tainted Scepter cutting healing on every hero hit.
Forticus shielded Shinbi when hit by heroes, on a cooldown, and grew max health for 3s each trade, stacking with Circle Rhythm's shield in fights.
Each cast stacked Aion's mana regeneration, which Arcane Resonance turned into faster Line Tempo and Rushing Beat cooldowns; Sacrifice restored part of missing mana when abilities hit heroes.
Molotov's Fire Field and ignited Oil Spill ticked ability damage repeatedly, refreshing Megacosm and adding Entropy, at most once every 0.2s per ability and target.
Vesh turned part of Molotov, Oil Spill and Inferno hits on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot added current-health damage; Lich's magical lifesteal healed Iggy.
Tainted Scepter cut target healing on magical hits and stacked Malice, maxed by takedowns, for bonus ability damage; Wraith Leggings boosted ability damage to heroes below 40% health.
Basic attacks with Ashbringer cut Vaporize and Vortex Grenade cooldowns 8% on heroes, once per ability, more on critical strikes; faster casts re-armed Solaris's healing empowered attack.
Rocket Dash set off Wind-Rider's attack speed for 4s; hitting heroes below 30% health fired Weald's true-damage missiles, 10s cooldown per hero; Forage added farm gold and experience.
Tainted Rounds cut target healing on basic attacks, with bonus damage rising as health dropped; Imperator added 30% to critical strikes, which Ventilate's bullets land at 75% effectiveness.
Essence Catalyst healed Phase and the Linked Ally after every cast; each heal gave that hero Exarch's attack speed and bonus magical damage on basic attacks.
With Fervour, basic attacks on heroes healed Phase and nearby allies, refreshing Exarch; Preservation boosted healing and shields Phase received, including Essence Catalyst's heal.
Hyperflux gave Phase and the Linked Ally attack speed and ability haste for 8s, so more casts and basic attacks fed Essence Catalyst and Fervour heals.
